caption: The video depicts an industrial workshop interior where a bearded man wearing a yellow hard hat and high-visibility vest stands before large orange robotic arms. He holds a tablet in his left hand and a stylus in his right, initially looking down at the device. As the sequence continues, his head lifts and his gaze turns toward the camera while the tablet rotates in his hands from a tilted position to a vertical one. Its dark face becomes pointed outward, and he draws it closer against his torso. The stylus shifts orientation to point downward beneath the tablet. The robotic arms remain largely still behind him, with black end-effectors and cabling visible. Orange robot bases, black hoses, and metal fixtures fill the background. He maintains direct eye contact with the camera while holding the tablet upright against his chest.
relations: Man's downward gaze -> head lifts and eyes turn toward camera while tablet rotates upright against torso.
Tablet held in left hand -> dark face points outward as it rotates from tilted to vertical.
Stylus in right hand -> orientation shifts to point downward beneath the upright tablet.
Orange robotic arms behind -> remain largely still with black end-effectors and cabling visible.
